newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Perstorp in JV with Australia's Langhall.
newsitem.headline: Perstorp in JV with Australia's Langhall.

text.p: Swedish plastics and chemicals group Perstorp AB on Monday said it was starting a sales company on a joint venture basis with Australia's Langhall Pty Ltd in the next few months.
Perstorp said in a statement that the new company would be called Perstorp Plastics Systems Pty Ltd and would be based in Brisbane, Queensland.
Perstorp would own 49 percent of the company with an option to increase its stake by a further 17 percent.
It said Langhall rents out pallets in Australia and New Zealand but also over the past year has increased its workload by selling Perstorp's material handling products that are made in plastic.
"This is Perstorp's first business in Australia," said Wiking Henricsson, head of the division Perstorp Plastic Systems.
"The aim of the new company is to develop the market for material handling and waste disposal products in Australia and New Zealand."
Henricsson said the Australian market is estimated to be worth A$100 million and Perstorp believed it could win 10-15 percent of this trade within three years.
